subject: Segmented console + API onboarding — proposed plan and slots
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>

Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Segmented console + API onboarding — proposed plan and slots

Hi Alyssa,

Thanks again for the chat last week — excited to get FinTrust into a short onboarding run so your team can start iterating on the Redwood Console and API. To make the session practical for two different audiences (integrations/devs vs product/ops), we typically split into two compact hands-on sessions rather than one long meeting. That helps keep latency-sensitive API work focused and the console walkthrough targeted.

Proposed plan (all times PT):
- Session A: API deep-dive + quick hands-on lab — 75 minutes
  * Option 1: Wed, Dec 7 — 10:00–11:15 PT
  * Option 2: Thu, Dec 8 — 13:00–14:15 PT

- Session B: Console walkthrough + admin controls — 75 minutes
  * Option 1: Fri, Dec 9 — 10:00–11:15 PT
  * Option 2: Mon, Dec 12 — 09:00–10:15 PT

If those windows don't work, tell me two preferred windows next week and we'll adjust. Please also confirm: a) who from FinTrust will attend each session (devs for API; product/ops for console), and b) whether you want the sessions recorded.

I attached a first-draft agenda and a short prework checklist (sandbox access + curl snippet) to speed things up. If you want a single combined session instead, we can compress to ~2.5 hours but recommend a 10–15 minute break in the middle.

I'll loop Camila (Console lead) and Vivek (API/infra) to assign instructors based on what you pick.

Thanks —
David
David Kim
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[david.kim@redwood.com] | +1 (415) 555-0172

Hi David —

Appreciate the clear plan. The team likes the two-session approach. The proposed Dec 7 morning conflicts with a board review; the team asked if we could shift to the Dec 8 / Dec 10 windows instead. Concrete ask:
- Can we do API hands-on on Thu, Dec 8 at 1:00 PM PT? That timing works best for our engineering squad.
- Console walkthrough on Fri, Dec 10 at 9:00 AM PT would be ideal for product and security.

A couple of notes:
- We'd prefer to have the API session first (engineering needs the sandbox early).
- Procurement (our contracts lead) would like to join the console session to cover data residency and logging — can we add them to the invite?
- Are sessions recorded? We may want a recording for folks who can't make it.

If those times are doable, we can lock them in. I'll also share a short list of attendees after I confirm with my manager.

Thanks,
